messages:
Oliver M: Hi folks, noticed FICA (SS/Med) deducted on my last 3 paystubs after my relocation to France on 06/01. I submitted the EU secondment form and posted A1 certificate already.
Nadia (People Ops): Sorry about that, Oliver. Can you confirm the secondment start date and attach the A1 copy? Payroll sometimes needs the A1 uploaded to the tax vendor to stop FICA.
Oliver M: Secondment start 2026-06-01. Uploaded A1 to Workday on 06/02 and flagged the employee tax form. Attached DM with PDF.
Sam - Payroll: Thanks. I see the Workday flag but our tax vendor feed to ADP missed the A1 metadata on 06/03 due to a sync error. That left your US tax status as 'subject to FICA' for June/July payrolls. We'll run a retro audit.
Oliver M: Will that mean I get a refund for FICA withheld? Also worried about employer-side filings.
Sam - Payroll: If audit confirms we should have exempted you, we can reverse the employee FICA with an off-cycle net reissue and correct employer taxes via payroll tax adjustments. For 941 reporting, adjustments will be filed in the next quarter as a reconciliation (Form 941-X) if needed. If too late we may coordinate with TaxOps for manual corrections.
TaxOps Bot: Case TAX-4210 opened: "A1 not synced - Oliver M". ETA 5 business days for audit + corrections.
Nadia (People Ops): We're on it. Sam, please prioritize the sync fix and confirm once the A1 is linked in the vendor system. Oliver, we'll update this thread when TAX-4210 closes. :white_check_mark:
